'''B5-2T''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that relayed to the Republic strike team a message from [[Satele Shan]] regarding the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|Starship]] ''[[Allusis]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
B5-2T is the courier for the flashpoint "Mandalorian Raiders".<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
